ctx.x: And uhm, I don't hear this commercial stuff and I don't want to be involved in it in the first place, so I let them know that I don't like it and I don't want to be involved with it and uh, this uh, Nat, he even invited me outside, he wanted to fight me because I said what I said, but I said I had to be truthful to myself, man.
